title: Hussain Ibne Ali ka charcha
body:
hussainiyat ka alam hai uncha
nikal ke batil se haq ki janib
kaha ye hur ne bhi misle rahib
na jaane hoga khuda wo kaisa
hai jiska banda husssain jaisa
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb karbobala jo pohnche
salaam-e-zainab ko sunke bole
tamache rukh par lagaye khud ke
hai aale ahmed pe waqt kaisa
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
zamaane wale ye sabr dekhe
jo aaye ran se pisar ke laashe
pisar ke lashou'n ke beech maa ne
kiya hai shukre khuda ka sajda
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
sada-e-halmin ko sun ke asghar
pider ke hataou pa ran me aakar
gale pa teer-e-sitam ko khakar
ye muskura kar adu se bola
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
jawaa'n pisar ke jigar se barchhi
na jaane kaise pidar ne khainchi
hai sabr e ayyoob ko bhi sakta
hai kitna saber ali ka beta
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
kate jo bazu jari ke ran me
kaha ye zainab ne roke ban me ke zalimou ne usey hai maara
jo tha muhafiz meri rida ka
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jaake maa ko koi sunaye
dulhan ko jaake koi sambhale
aba me sarwar jise hai laaye
wo hai hasan ke pisar ka lasha
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
bayaa'n ho manzar bhala wo kaise
jo teer barsaaye fouj-e-keen ne
na zeen per tha na tha zamee'n par
<<MINI>>
hussain ibne ali ka lasha
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tashnagi aur wo garm sehra aur us pe zehra ka laal tanha
samaa qayamat se kam nahi tha aur uspe shukre khuda ka sajda
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
ye naam-e-saqqa se anjuman hai
ye matamiye shah-e-zaman hai
rahegi ye hashr tak salamat
zubaan pa inke sada rahega
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
<<DIVIDER>>
likhe bhala kaise pal wo ajmal
rawaa'n hai ankhou'n se ashk har pal
kaha ye khanjar ne khud bhi rokar
gulu-e-sarwar bahot hai sukha
<<MINI>>
na ruk saka hai na ruk sakega
hussain ibne ali ka charcha
